page.overview:
Who is Amy?

Amy is a fellow student that Andrew Teen (also known as the "squeaky-voiced teen") has a crush on. She makes her first and only appearance in "Full Heart, Empty Pool".

Amy sits in front of Andrew in math class. He also named his pet guinea pig after her.

Andrew had planned an elaborate "promposal", using the money from all of his after-school jobs to pay for a skywriter. However, he can no longer be present because he gets served with a subpoena to be a surprise witness in Homer's against Builders' Barn. Even Andrew's parents doubt Amy will accept, believing she will go to the prom with somebody named Josh instead.

Later, Andrew and Amy are shown holding hands, showing that he won her over after all. She tells Andrew that he is so brave for testifying in court. When she kisses him, his voice deepens.
